title: Reduce today's load
action: Pick three tasks, defer the rest, and start the smallest high-priority action.
expectedBenefit: Reduces decision fatigue and creates visible progress.

title: Start a short focus block
action: Run a 25-minute focus session on one task before adding new work.

title: Close the loop with reflection
action: Write a short reflection and choose tomorrow's first action.
expectedBenefit: Improves planning quality for the next day.

title: Protect recovery before adding pressure
action: Cut the task list, finish one essential task, and schedule sleep or recovery.
expectedBenefit: Prevents false productivity while preserving consistency.

title: Clear overdue tasks now
action: Pick the oldest overdue task. Rescope it to a 30-minute block or cancel it. Do not add new tasks until one overdue item is resolved.
expectedBenefit: Stops deadline debt from compounding and restores execution clarity.

title: Rebuild focus consistency
action: Schedule a fixed 20-minute daily focus block at the same time for 5 consecutive days.
expectedBenefit: Consistent timing reduces startup friction and builds a measurable execution habit.

title: Move a stalled goal forward
action: Pick one goal with no recent progress. Create a single 30-minute task toward it today.
expectedBenefit: Re-activates momentum on long-horizon goals before they are quietly abandoned.

title: Protect this momentum
action: Keep today's task count at 3 or fewer. Avoid adding new work mid-session.
expectedBenefit: Preserves the conditions that created the streak.

title: Move critical work earlier
action: Identify which tasks are being done late. Schedule them before 9pm tomorrow.
expectedBenefit: Sleep-quality improvements compound over days; late-night execution carries higher error rates.

title: Maintain the stable pace
action: Continue the current task rhythm. Introduce one new goal or habit only when the existing cadence is consistent for 7+ days.
expectedBenefit: Prevents growth from destabilizing a working system.
